mil3.1.6:1.2: “Venerable Nāgasena, is there anyone who dies and is not reborn?”
mil3.1.6:1.4: “Some are reborn, and some are not reborn.”
mil3.1.6:1.5: “Who is reborn, and who is not reborn?”
mil3.1.6:1.6: “One with defilements is reborn, Great King; one without defilements is not reborn.”
mil3.1.6:1.7: “But you, Venerable Nāgasena, will you be reborn?”
mil3.1.6:1.8: “If I am still grasping, Great King, I will be reborn; if I am not grasping, I will not be reborn.”
